Root.description:
Represents the radio button itself.
Renders a `<span>` element and a hidden `<input>` beside.

props.name: value*
props.description: The unique identifying value of the radio in a group.

props.name: nativeButton
props.description:
Whether the component renders a native `<button>` element when replacing it
via the `render` prop.
Set to `true` if the rendered element is a native button.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the component should ignore user interaction.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Whether the user should be unable to select the radio button.

props.name: required
props.description: Whether the user must choose a value before submitting a form.

props.name: inputRef
props.description: A ref to access the hidden input element.

props.name: class
props.description:
CSS class applied to the element, or a function that
returns a class based on the component's state.

props.name: style
props.description:
Style applied to the element, or a function that
returns a style object based on the component's state.

props.name: render
props.description: Replace the default element with a tag name, component, or render function.

dataAttributes.name: data-checked
dataAttributes.description: Present when the radio is checked.

dataAttributes.name: data-unchecked
dataAttributes.description: Present when the radio is not checked.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the radio is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-readonly
dataAttributes.description: Present when the radio is readonly.

dataAttributes.name: data-required
dataAttributes.description: Present when the radio is required.

dataAttributes.name: data-valid
dataAttributes.description: Present when the radio is in a valid state (when wrapped in Field.Root).

dataAttributes.name: data-invalid
dataAttributes.description: Present when the radio is in an invalid state (when wrapped in Field.Root).

dataAttributes.name: data-dirty
dataAttributes.description: Present when the radio's value has changed (when wrapped in Field.Root).

dataAttributes.name: data-touched
dataAttributes.description: Present when the radio has been touched (when wrapped in Field.Root).

dataAttributes.name: data-filled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the radio is checked (when wrapped in Field.Root).

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Present when the radio is focused (when wrapped in Field.Root).

additionalTypes.name: Root.State

props.name: style

props.name: keepMounted

RadioGroup.description:
Provides shared state to a series of radio buttons.
Renders a `<div>` element.

props.name: name
props.description: Identifies the field when a form is submitted.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The uncontrolled value of the radio button that should be initially selected. To render a controlled radio group, use the `value` prop instead.

props.name: value
props.description: The controlled value of the radio item that should be currently selected. To render an uncontrolled radio group, use the `defaultValue` prop instead.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Callback fired when the value changes.

props.name: form
props.description:
Identifies the form that owns the radio inputs.
Useful when the radio group is rendered outside the form.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the component should ignore user interaction.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Whether the user should be unable to select a different radio button in the group.

props.name: required
props.description: Whether the user must choose a value before submitting a form.

props.name: inputRef
props.description: A ref to access the hidden input element.

props.name: class
props.description:
CSS class applied to the element, or a function that
returns a class based on the component's state.

props.name: style
props.description:
Style applied to the element, or a function that
returns a style object based on the component's state.

props.name: render
props.description: Replace the default element with a tag name, component, or render function.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the radio group is disabled.

additionalTypes.name: RadioGroup.State
